newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian interbank rates steady, supply good.
newsitem.headline: Croatian interbank rates steady, supply good.

text.p: Croatian interbank rates remained steady in balanced trade on Friday amid good supply of kuna, money market dealers said.
"It is a typical busy Friday. Both demand and supply are quite high," said one dealer.
Fresh trade totalled a high 52 million kuna by 0900 GMT as banks borrowed more money for the weekly turnover tax payments by their clients.
Call money deals were struck at 8.0 percent, with 30- and 60-day rates at 15 and 17 percent, respectively.
The banking sector ended Thursday with 473 million kuna in their accounts and 6.3 million shorfalls at four banks which they squared through overnight borrowings on the money market.

Liquidity is expected to improve further after the central bank paid banks some 450 million kuna this morning for the purchase of hard currency earlier this week. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
